login.biometric_not_detected: Biometrics not detected. We will try anyway.
login.biometric_failed: Biometric authentication failed. Please try again.
login.biometric_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please unlock your device and try again.
login.biometric_failed_use_password: Biometric authentication failed. Try your password instead.

onboarding_choice.title: Set up Gossip
onboarding_choice.body: Create new accounts on this device or restore accounts from a Gossip backup.
onboarding_choice.create_body: Start fresh with unique passwords and optional device-local biometrics.
onboarding_choice.import_body: Restore selected accounts from a .gossipbackup file.

import.title: Import Accounts
import.replace_title: This replaces secure accounts on this device
import.replace_body: Import never merges. Only the accounts whose passwords you enter will be restored. Existing secure accounts are permanently replaced.
import.password_notice: You need the unique password for every account you want to restore. Passwords stay in memory only during this import.
import.biometric_notice: Biometric login is not included. Configure it again on this device after import.
import.possession_notice: Anyone with this file can try passwords offline. Keep the backup private.
import.choose_file_body: Choose one read-only .gossipbackup file. Gossip will not modify or delete it.
import.unsupported: Safe streaming import is not available in this browser.
import.invalid_file: This backup could not be validated. Choose an intact, supported Gossip backup.
import.load_account_body: Enter one account password at a time. Gossip reveals an account only after its password is authenticated.
import.invalid_password: That password was not accepted. Check it and try again.
import.confirm_body: The listed accounts will replace secure accounts currently stored by Gossip on this device. This cannot be undone.
import.install_failed: Import could not be committed. Your confirmed accounts are frozen and available for an exact safe retry.
import.terminal_failed: Password admission failed and this candidate was securely closed. Choose the backup again to retry.
import.cleanup_failed: Gossip could not finish secure cleanup. Retry before leaving this screen.
import.retry_restart: Restart and choose the backup again
import.failed: The import operation failed. Please try again.
import.success_body: Your selected accounts are installed and locked. Sign in with any restored account password. Configure biometrics again if wanted.

create.title: Create Account
create.username_min_length: Username must be at least 3 characters long
create.biometric_not_supported: Biometric login is not available on this device. You can continue with password login.
create.password_security_info: Your account will be secured using a password. Make sure to choose a strong password.
create.unique_password_title: Use a unique password for each account.
create.unique_password_warning: Gossip uses the password to identify the account during login, so passwords cannot be shared between accounts.
create.biometric_security_info: Your account will be secured using biometric authentication (fingerprint, face ID, or Windows Hello).
create.biometric_prf_unsupported: This passkey provider is not compatible with secure biometric key derivation. Use your device passkey (Touch ID, Face ID, or Windows Hello) instead.
create.failed: Failed to create account. Please try again.
create.success_message: Your account has been created successfully.
create.password_confirm_message: Have you memorized your password? Without it, access to this account will be permanently lost.
create.background_sync_title: Receive messages while the app is closed
create.background_sync_description: On Android, the system may suspend the app as soon as it is in the background, delaying reception. You can enable a high-reliability mode that keeps a persistent notification to keep sync active. It uses a bit more battery. You can change this later in settings.

select.title: Select Account
select.failed: Failed to load accounts. Please try again.
select.no_accounts_desc: You don't have any accounts yet. Create a new account to get started.

secure_setup.title: Secure Storage Setup
secure_setup.warning_create_more: This device can hold several completely isolated accounts. If someone forces you to unlock the app, you can hand over the password of a decoy account — it is mathematically impossible to prove that another account exists on this phone. To enable this protection, create at least one additional account now.
secure_setup.info: You can create additional accounts for plausible deniability. Each account has its own password and data.
secure_setup.password_in_use: This password is already used by another account. Choose a unique password.
secure_setup.lock_failed: Your accounts were saved, but the app could not lock them. Retry before continuing.
secure_setup.cleanup_failed: Gossip could not finish cleaning up after an error. Retry cleanup. If the problem persists, report the issue.
secure_setup.batch_failed: Something went wrong while creating your accounts. Please try again. If the problem persists, report the issue.

biometric_setup.title: Login with Biometrics
biometric_setup.onboarding_info: Enable biometrics for one account. Your password is still required for import and recovery.
biometric_setup.onboarding_warning: Only one account can use biometric login. Select the account you want to use with biometrics.
biometric_setup.icloud_prompt: Store your biometric login password in iCloud Keychain?
biometric_setup.icloud_benefit: Keep the biometric login password in iCloud Keychain instead of only on this device.
biometric_setup.icloud_warning: Enabling sync stores this account password in iCloud Keychain and makes it available beyond this device. Keep it local to limit the credential to this device.
